name: agentforge
description: AgentForge makes Claude the commander and reviewer and Cursor the hands-on worker: Claude plans, splits, and accepts the work while a background Cursor agent implements it. This saves Claude tokens, lowers cost, and cuts the friction of switching between tools. Control auto-dispatch, executor, model, thinking effort, permission, and SDD task documents from the AgentForge board (/forge-board).

board.title: Board
board.description: How the AgentForge board appears. auto opens it when a session starts, until you close it in that session; button shows a one-line status with an Open board button above the prompt while the board is closed; command opens it only with /forge-board. Dispatch settings themselves are changed on the board.
